note: Replaces the long concatenated ternary constant with a buildFlagChangeVerbPhrase function composing named sub-expressions joined per branch.
Adds static _assert_web_experiment_has_control and calls it from create, launch validation, and update (update keeps its variants guard).
Replaces tag_queries calls with tags_context with-blocks wrapping each sync_execute in the viewset methods.
EventKindSpec now holds neutral (label, value) details; separate Slack and Teams renderers format them; slack-to-teams markdown converter removed.
Removes ensure_source_enabled and makes scanner findings self-authorizing signals, bypassing SignalSourceConfig for scanner sources.
Renames producer env config to Warpstream/MSK-prefixed vars; consumer still receives a separate kafkaProducer alongside outputs.
Imports and uses get_token(data, request) instead of reading api_key directly from the payload.
Drops the actionability_is_new/priority_is_new/new_finding_ids fields in favor of old/new artefact lists; previous_assessment_correct stays in update schemas.
Replaces the manual offset pagination loop with api.loadPaginatedResults on the generated list URL.
Adds a productPrefix helper used by both checkProductStaleness and getProductDuration; double traversal remains.
Removes the documented activation exception and adds status-only enable/disable/archive MCP tools plus view guards; no serializer validation added.
Changes dependency-id resolution to parse flag filters by id or key; does not extract the per-target dependency-copy block into a helper.
Directory rename lanes to pipelines; the test file still imports deleteKeysWithPrefix from the cdp test helpers.
Moves CSV export into membersExportLogic and uses the shared slugify util from lib/utils instead of inline regex slugging.
Adds Discord destination with another type if-branch and a template enum; no registry or strategy dispatch introduced.
Renames viewset to SignalProcessingViewSet with a top-level list GET returning paused_until; pause is PUT/DELETE on one route.
Replaces the custom suppressed event with the existing issue status update event, adding status and source properties.
Removes the arbitrary Tailwind selector and passes a new highlightVariant subtle prop added to PropertiesTable.
Extracts ongoing-interval show/checked/disabledReason/tooltip logic into an ongoingIntervalField util in alertFormLogic with tests.
extract_hogql_features now returns a HogQLFeatures dataclass instead of a (tables, events) tuple; callers updated.
